title: Type Detector analysis: possible future enhancements
disposition: Saved for future consideration; no implementation authorized

inspected: Maintained client, server, and shared production TypeScript
Selected related tests and existing domain representations
scope.limits: Selective read-only survey, not an exhaustive audit. Tests and builds were not run. No new Type names were adopted.

possibleEnhancements.subject: Refine the existing TestRunCacheStatus alternatives
possibleEnhancements.observation: Status and independently nullable fields permit contradictory combinations such as available=false with status=passed, or status=empty with a populated exit code. The producer emits distinct empty and populated alternatives.
possibleEnhancements.concreteInstance: An empty cache has no result.
possibleEnhancements.contrastingExample: A completed passing run has result metadata.
possibleEnhancements.proposal: Refine the existing Type into correlated variants derived from actual producer behavior and tests; no separate domain concept is needed.
possibleEnhancements.benefit: Reject contradictory combinations at compile time.
possibleEnhancements.riskOrLimit: The Type does not validate persisted JSON at runtime; update consumers without changing intended cache behavior.
possibleEnhancements.nextStep: Reinspect the producer, consumers, and empty/passed/failed/error tests, then establish the precise variants before implementation.

possibleEnhancements.subject: Clarify whether ticket dependency cycles are valid
possibleEnhancements.observation: Dependencies are directed and many-to-many. The server checks referenced ticket existence; no cycle test was identified in the inspected dependency tests.
possibleEnhancements.concreteInstance: Ticket A depends on ticket B.
possibleEnhancements.contrastingExample: Tickets A and B depend on each other.
possibleEnhancements.proposal: Ask whether reciprocal and longer cycles are valid before adding any constraint.
possibleEnhancements.benefit: If cycles are forbidden, graph validation can reject invalid dependencies.
possibleEnhancements.riskOrLimit: Forbidding cycles without agreement would invent a domain rule. A Type alone cannot enforce graph-wide validity.
possibleEnhancements.nextStep: Obtain the user's decision on cycle semantics.

possibleEnhancements.subject: Investigate timestamp validation contracts if a concrete need emerges
possibleEnhancements.observation: Timestamp strings occur across shared records. Some producers parse or normalize them, but the survey did not establish one shared validation contract.
possibleEnhancements.concreteInstance: Ticket framing parses and serializes reportedAt.
possibleEnhancements.contrastingExample: No independently traced contrasting timestamp contract was established in this survey.
possibleEnhancements.proposal: Trace actual timestamp producers and consumers before proposing a shared abstraction.
possibleEnhancements.benefit: Potentially clarify accepted formats and validation boundaries if evidence supports a shared contract.
possibleEnhancements.riskOrLimit: A string alias alone would not validate serialized values. Different timestamps may have different meanings.
possibleEnhancements.nextStep: Only revisit when a concrete ambiguity or validation requirement warrants it; discuss candidate names before adoption.

leaveAsIs.subject: Workflow status labels
leaveAsIs.reason: Statuses intentionally preserve descriptive document labels, including Awaiting review. A fixed union would remove intended flexibility without an established invariant.

leaveAsIs.subject: Estimate parsing outcomes
leaveAsIs.reason: TicketEstimate already represents the complete three-rating value. Absent, valid, and invalid input are tested; the private invalid sentinel is immediately handled.
leaveAsIs.revisitWhen: Parsing gains more consumers or additional outcomes.

leaveAsIs.subject: Clone destination representation
leaveAsIs.reason: Boundary validation expresses meaningful constraints. A named path Type cannot guarantee that filesystem facts remain unchanged. This observation does not settle the separate deferred clone safety work.

positiveExamples.subject: Explicit ticket lifecycle alternatives
positiveExamples.observation: Existing status and command/result unions model lifecycle alternatives and provide prior art for future refinements.

resume: Start with the TestRunCacheStatus refinement if implementation is requested. Recheck current code and evidence first; saved line anchors describe the reviewed version and may drift.
